LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Fl. ac.]
Acute stitches in right hip-bone.
Lameness in left hip.
Coxalgia.
Œdematous swelling of legs up to abdomen. θ Ascites.
Left leg goes "to sleep" easily.
Varicosis of lower limbs.
Varicose veins upon legs, tend to ulceration.
Pain in right knee-joint.
Synovitis of knee-joint ; much pain, followed by dropsy.
Top of foot œdematous ; instep.
Chronic ulcerations on feet, particularly about joints and on tibia ; bones more or less affected.
Burning stitches in soles.
Feet hot and burn much.
Soreness between toes.
Soreness of all the corns.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Fl. ac.]
Pain in all the limbs, with weakness and numbness.
Limbs go to sleep, although he does not lie on them.
Feet and hands excessively moist.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Fl. ac.]
Many symptoms < when standing, though > when standing than when sitting.
Can only lie in an elevated position.
Cannot lie down.
Has to be propped up in bed.
Limbs go to sleep, although he does not lie on them.
Vertigo compels her to sit down.
Motion : heaviness above eyes with nausea < ; accelerates pulse ; pain in os coccygis < ; nausea ; clammy sweat.
Bending backwards : oppression of chest > ; aching in os sacrum and lumbar region >.
Bending head back : hardness of hearing >.
Talking : tongue painful.
Can hardly walk across room.
   

NERVES. [36] [Fl. ac.]
Increased ability to exercise his muscles without fatigue ; is less affected by excessive heat in summer or cold in winter.
Sensation of going to sleep of side not lain on.
Limbs go to sleep, although he does not lie on them.
Lassitude.
Great diurnal languor. θ Secondary syphilis.
Loss of strength ; great prostration and fear of death.
Coccyodynia, with excessive aching, especially in rheumatic subjects.
Progressive locomotor ataxia.
Tabes dorsalis with great excitement of sexual system.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Fl. ac.]
Drowsiness.
Sleep earlier in evening ; sudden sleepiness.
Loss of sleep in evening, from crowding of thoughts.
Sleeplessness, without inclination to sleep ; a short sleep suffices and refreshes him.
Sleep restless and unrefreshing. θ Dropsy.
Dreams towards morning.
   

TIME. [38] [Fl. ac.]
Morning : good memory ; anxiety > ; moodiness >, headache ; great sensitiveness to noise ; mouth and teeth coated with mucus ; viscid, tasteless saliva in mouth ; constriction of throat ; watery diarrhœa with protrusion of anus ; offensive yellowish-brown stools ; soft small stools ; early, dejections, yellow drops from urethra ; hawking of phlegm ; dreams.
At 4 A. M. : discharge of yellow bilious matter.
During day : diarrhœa ; bilious diarrhœa < ; pain in index-finger.
At 3 P. M. : headache behind ears.
Afternoon : difficult breathing ; clammy sweat.
Evening : forgets everything ; anxiety < ; moodiness ; great appetite ; soft small stools ; protrusion of hemorrhoids ; difficult breathing ; sleep earlier ; loss of sleep from crowding of thoughts ; clammy sweat.
Night : congestion of blood to forehead and dulness in occiput towards night ; dejections ; involuntary discharge of urine ; erections ; gleety discharge ; pains in bones ; pains <.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Fl. ac.]
Is less susceptible to extreme heat of summer and cold of winter.
Worse in wet, cold weather.
Must keep eyes tied up and warm.
Warm drinks cause bilious diarrhœa.
Teeth feel warm.
Desire to wash hot face with cold water.
Cold drink : toothache <.
Ulcers > by washing or sponging them with cold water, < from heat applied. (Silic. has reverse).
   

FEVER. [40] [Fl. ac.]
Chill entirely wanting.
General heat, with nausea from slightest motion, with inclination to uncover, and to wash with cold water.
Face constantly hot, wants to bathe it continually in cold water.
Heat returns every evening with frequent pulse and thirst, lasting 3 to 4 hours. θ Intermittent.
Hectic fever, with sour sweat, emaciation and great debility.
Rheumatic fever, or gout, with sour, clammy, fetid sweat.
Decubitus. θ Typhoid fever.
Clammy, sour and unpleasant smelling sweat, mostly on upper body, particularly during exercise in afternoon and evening.
Heat and sweat of palms of hands.
Perspiration particularly in face.
Sweat excessive on feet.
The sweat promotes excoriation and decubitus.
One-sided sweat, left side ; sweat on diseased part.
Better during sweat.
Symptoms following typhus fever.
   

ATTACKS, PERIODICITY. [41] [Fl. ac.]
Frequent urging to make water.
Twice a day : evacuations.
Twenty-four hours : six to eight evacuations.
Every day for a week at same hour : discharge of yellow bilious matter.
Every morning : headache.
Every evening : heat returns lasting three to four hours.
Alternate days : aggravation an hour later each time.
Every three or four days : scar begins to itch.
   

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [Fl. ac.]
Right : pain in temples ; numbness of bones around ear ; itching on side on nose ; lower jaw swollen ; violent pains at root of eye-tooth ; pressure on gum over eye-tooth ; back part of mouth, painful little ulcer ; hypochondrium sensitive to pressure ; itching on side of nose ; pain in shoulder-joint ; slight lameness of arm ; trembling of biceps and triceps of arm.
Left : dulness in side of head ; pain in temple ; side of head retarded in growth ; eye seems smaller ; pain in inner canthus ; lachrymal fistula on side ; pimple on wing of nose ; pressing pain in arm ; itching under ribs ; lobe of liver enlarged and indurated ; pain from side of chest to groin ; rumbling pain most acute in side ; itching on breast ; itching of nipple ; rheumatic pains in arm ; pain in index-finger ; first and second phalanx of index-finger swollen ; one-sided sweat.
Right to left : pain in temples.
Symptoms seem to go from below up.
Within outward : pressing in temples.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Fl. ac.]
As if danger menaced him ; brain feels as if on the verge of being struck with apoplexy ; as if in an earthquake ; as of a cold wind blowing under lids even in a warm room ; as if sand were in eyes ; as if he must wink ; as if something were in eye that could be rubbed out ; as if air was passing down from shoulder-joint to fingers ; pain as if in bone of left index-finger ; as if a burning vapor was emitted from pores of whole body.
Pain : in right temple ; in sutures behind ears ; from nape extending through centre of head to forehead ; in left inner canthus ; in chronic nasitis ; in tongue ; from left side of chest to groin ; about navel ; in abdomen ; urine painful in passing ; in third cervical vertebra ; in os coccygis ; in right shoulder-joint ; in right knee-joint ; in all the limbs ; in bones.
Violent pains at root of right eye-tooth.
Severe pain : in lower abdomen.
Stitches : in right hip-bone ; in soles.
Sharp darting pains about half an inch in length, like streaks of lightning.
Sticking pains at root of thumb-nail.
Pinching in region of spleen ; in stomach ; about navel.
Griping in abdomen.
Burning pain : on small spots of skin.
Bruised pain : in sacrum.
Pressing pain : in region of spleen ; in left arm ; in vertex.
Compressing pain : in temples.
Rumbling pain : in left side.
Rheumatism : in arms and shoulders.
Dull heavy headache : in forehead.
Sore pain : at heart.
Aching : in bladder ; in os sacrum ; in lumbar region.
Burning : in eyes ; in ears ; in stomach ; about navel ; before and after urination ; in hands.
Soreness : of larynx ; at heart ; between toes ; of all the corns.
Raw feeling : of trachea.
Irritability : of throat ; of larynx.
Sensitiveness : of teeth.
Constriction : in throat ; of anus.
Oppression : of chest.
Heat : at stomach.
Distension : of abdomen.
Fulness : in head ; in epigastrium ; in both spermatic cords ; of glans penis ; lower part of scrotum.
Pricking : of tongue ; in fingers.
Tingling : of tongue.
Emptiness : in region of navel.
Singing : in ears.
Ringing : in ears.
Roughness : of teeth.
Dryness : of larynx ; of trachea.
Dulness : of head ; in occiput.
Pressing : in both temples ; in occiput ; as if behind right eyeball ; in epigastrium.
Heaviness : above eyes ; of teeth.
Weight : in stomach.
Lameness : in back ; in hip ; in legs ; in arms ; in shoulders ; in left hip.
Elastic feeling : in urinary organs.
Sinking weakness : in head.
Numbness : in forehead ; in hands ; in bones around ear ; of tongue ; of hands.
Sensation of going to sleep of side lain on ; legs go to sleep easily.
Itching : of head ; in canthi ; of fistula on left side of cheek ; in both ears ; on right side of nose ; under ribs ; within and around anus ; on left breast ; on right side of nose ; of right nipple ; in larynx ; of skin ; of ulcers.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Fl. ac.]
Atrophy of brain.
Chronic irritation of mucous membranes.
Emaciation. θ Dropsy.
Muscles soft and flabby. θ Chronic diarrhœa.
Alopecia.
Goitre.
Liver enlarged and indurated.
Dropsy of drunkards.
Acute suppurations.
Threatening gangrene in swollen scrotum and penis.
Varicose veins of legs.
Nevus, flat.
Varicose veins, obstinate and long standing cases, especially in women who have borne many children.
Varicose ulcers.
Pains in the bones.
Swelling of bones.
Osteitis.
Exostoses and nightly pains in bones.
Diseases of bones, particularly of long bones ; suppurate and get better and worse periodically ; pains < at night, with great prostration.
Diseases of bones ; particularly of long bones ; caries and necrosis, especially when they are of a psoric or syphilitic nature ; or from abuse of mercury.
Promotes expulsion of necrotic bones.
Syphilis.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Fl. ac.]
Touch : sore pain in os coccygis.
Pressure : scab on cheek painful to ; right hypochondrium sensitive ; liver sensitive ; of clothes > ; emptiness in region of navel ; > aching in os sacrum and lumbar region ; makes pain extend from os coccygis through to bladder.
Bedsores on parts which do not sweat much.
Decubitus. θ Typhus.
   

SKIN. [46] [Fl. ac.]
Sallow skin.
Skin grayish-white. θ Dropsy.
Burning pains on small spots of skin.
Itching of skin.
Sensation as if a burning vapor was emitted from the pores of the whole body.
Elevated red blotches.
Several small round blood-vesicles, elevated, of a light carmine color, soft and compressible and resembling little flesh warts.
Skin tubercles on forehead and face, even when ulcerating ; elevated red blotches on palm of hands ; squamous eruptions on body (psoriasis guttata) ; syphilitic erosions, mucous tubercles ; exostoses and nightly pains in bones.
Frequent small boils ; carbuncles.
Pustules.
Dry cutaneous eruptions.
Squamous eruptions on body.
Nevus of children (on right temple) ; capillary aneurism.
Erosions, mucous tubercles.
Varicose veins and ulcers.
Ulcers : painful ; < from warmth, > from cold ; with copious discharge ; with red borders and vesicles.
Old cicatrices become red around edges, covered or surrounded by itching vesicles or they itch violently.
Bedsores ; nevi materni ; pimples.
Carious ulcers becoming < from too large or too frequently repeated doses of Silic.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Fl. ac.]
Complaints of old age, also premature old age, in consequence of syphilitic-mercurial dyscrasia.
Young people look very old.
Weakly constitutions, sallow skin, emaciation.
Secondary syphilis ; syphilis infantum.
Boy, æt. 9, after scarlet fever ; caries of temporal bone.
Man, æt. 24, primary sore two years ago which disappeared under use of blue pill, and topical application of black wash, four months afterwards had secondary ulceration of throat, which also temporarily healed under blue pill ; syphilis.
Mrs. G., suffering for a month ; diarrhœa.
Man, æt. 30, secondary symptoms for five or six months ; syphilis.
Man, æt. 32, formerly much troubled with scrofulous eruptions ; ulceration of uvula.
Man, æt. 40, subject to indigestion and attacks of bilious vomiting and diarrhœa nearly all his like ; diarrhœa and vomiting.
Mr. B., æt. 50 ; aural itching.
Man, æt. 59, weak constitution, hard drinker, has enlargement of liver ; dropsy.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Fl. ac.]
Compatible : after Arsen. in ascites from gindrinker's liver ; after Kali carb. in hip disease ; after Phos. ac. in diabetes ; after Silic. in bone affections.
Compare : Coca in increased ability to exercise ; Coffea in toothache ; Citr. ac. and Sepia in aversion to one's family ; Oxal. ac. in diarrhœa, < from coffee ; Rhus tox. and Ruta in coccygodynia ; Silic. in dental fistula, onychia, bone diseases and coccygodynia ; Spongia and Kali carb. in goitre ; Staphis. in sensitive teeth.
